name: Tamsin Coalbrook
note: Dagny Coalbrook's niece, a mage-smith who works iron with her hands and the Ember both (world doc §3.3, v1.53): the Reach's found companion (mage), held at the goblins' anvil in the Cold Seam's tally cave. Joins once the Foreman falls. Her chain, Showing Off, is Haldor's to give (v1.155).
